text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —It was truly the birth of a new legend.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—And she moves up into second!
Almond Eye has moved up into second place!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOH!! HERE SHE COMEEEES!!
GOOOOOOO! ALMOND EYEEEEEE!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Do your best!!!
Please winnnn!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead, Almond Eye!!
Almond Eye!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, is this where they make their move
to catch the leader!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —I'm the one who'll—!!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'LL WIN!!!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAARGH!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The lead changes hands right here!!
It's Almond Eyyyyyye!!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Not yetttttt!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye dodges, she dodges!
She pulls cleeeaaar!!!

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—She wins, she wins!!
It's Almond Eye!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A truly terrifying Umamusume:
Almond Eye!!

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (Ooooooohhhhh!?!?)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—What an incredible time!!
2 minutes!! 20 seconds!! POINT SIX!!!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She blasted across the line with an unbelievable time!!
Who could have ever imagined such a time being clocked?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
This is me!!
The horse girl who will forge a new legend!!

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Incredible...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...On that day, Loves Only You and I went to Tokyo Racecourse
to watch the GⅠ race, the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The name of the winning Umamusume was Almond Eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Victorious in this year's Oka Sho, Yushun Himba (Oaks), and Shuka Sho—the queen who seized the glory of the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And today, in a race packed with seven GⅠ Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Last year's Kikuka Sho Umamusume takes the lead,
setting the pace as the race unfolds.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In a tremendous battle where even the 6th-place finisher shattered the URA 2,400m turf track record—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite still being in the Classic tier,
she smashed the world record for the 2400m turf and achieved absolute victory in 1st place.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was truly the moment a horse girl heralding the dawn of a new era was born.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As a fellow Umamusume aiming for the Tiara route, I thought watching Almond Eye run would be good reference material,
so I came to watch the race with her, but—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Ah, sorry. I was kind of daydreaming, or rather—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...The lingering excitement of the race was still there.
choice_data_list: Honestly, that was an amazing run...
That really was an incredible run, huh...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I guess this is what it means
to feel 'overwhelmed.'

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So that's the running of the current Tiara...
No. The pinnacle of the era...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today's race seemed to be quite a shock to her as well.
In the end, she remained quiet all the way back to the academy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —That night.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, I watched the Japan Cup
in person today♪ Did you all watch it too?”

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
" 'Saw it, saw it!' 'That was amazing~!'
'The crowd was insane.' 'A world record?!'
'Haven't seen it yet.' 'Almond Eye is crazy!' "

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Right! Almond Eye-san's running was just so totally full of love...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Winning the Triple Tiara alone would go down in
history, but setting a world record to win the
Japan Cup while still in the Classic tier...?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: It's really... incredible. I'm sure she'll go on to achieve all kinds of great feats in the future.

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text: "Loves-chan, I'm sure you can make history just like Almond Eye-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"‘You'll definitely be able to achieve historic success’...
Hehe, thank you♪"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: That's right. We're aiming for the world, so I have to—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
............You know what.
Since it's you guys, I'll be honest—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Watching today's race, how should I put it...
Ai-san's running was just so dazzling...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Is it called 'a difference in caliber'?
I felt a little bit of that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Curious about how Loves Only You was doing today, I watched her evening stream, only to be caught off guard by some unexpected words from her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Did that historic run end up intimidating her instead?
As I watched the stream filled with anxiety—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
âAh, but don't worry!
It's not like I'm feeling down or anything."softening

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
True, for someone like me on the Tiara route, she's an unreachable figure up in the clouds,
but I'm still growing, after all!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "If anything, it's fired me up to aim high and do my best to reach Ai-san's level~♡"

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"So impressive~!" "Uh-huh, uh-huh"
"That's right, it's only just begun!" "So mature"
"Loves-chan can totally do it!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪
I'm going to keep going at my own pace from here on out, so
make sure to give me looots of cheers, okay?♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The next day.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
âAh, Trainer-kunâ¡
Let's do our best today, tooâª
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it our all today too!
Yeah, let's give it our all today too!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
âAh, Trainer-chanâ¡
Let's do our best today, tooâª
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it our all today too!
Yeah, let's give it our all today too!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Right, before we begin—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun, you were secretly watching yesterday's stream without saying a word, weren't you~?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, you were secretly watching
my stream yesterday without saying anything, weren't you~?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Well, obviously~
Like I'd ever miss out on that! ♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Did I make you worry?
choice_data_list: No, in fact, I realized my worries were completely unfounded.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I see.
Then that's great♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“......If I were on my own,
I don't think I would have been able to take it all in.”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"That was just how vivid
and dazzling Ai-san's running was."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I wondered if being only one generation apart... had driven her to despair.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Still—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I have my community members who support me,
telling me it's okay to go at my own pace."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: And even more than that...—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I have you by my side, believing so deeply in my potential—
you're sooooo reassuring♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I have you by my side, believing so deeply in my potential—
you're sooooo reassuring♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: So I'm totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Someday, I want to show the world too.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Just like Ai-san, a historic run...
the first in history...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll guide her there, no matter what.
As the bridge for Loves Only You.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I totally luv that about you, Trainer-kun♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "That side of you, Trainer-chan, is why I totally love you♡"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...The Junior Class was drawing to a close.
The next stage was already looming just ahead."
